labels_label_id: Unique Discogs identifier for the label.
labels_label_name: The label's name as listed on Discogs.
labels_label_contactinfo: Contact information provided for the label (address, email, etc.), when documented.
labels_label_data_quality: Discogs community data-quality flag for this entry (e.g. Correct, Needs Vote, Needs Major Changes).
label_urls_url: External reference URLs for the label (website, socials). A JSON array when multiple exist.
label_sublabels_label: Names of sublabels/imprints operating under this label.
label_sublabels_label_id: Discogs label IDs corresponding to each sublabel in label_sublabels_label.
labels_label_parentLabel: Name of this label's parent label, if it is itself a sublabel/imprint. (Confirmed from a real run: Discogs' XML tag is camelCase, not all-lowercase.)
labels_label_parentLabel_id: Discogs label ID of the parent label named in labels_label_parentLabel.
